input: Renew my professional association membership online

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which specific association it is determines the exact website, renewal portal, and steps involved — the process differs widely across associations.
Whether the membership is already expired or still active changes the urgency and whether late fees or re-enrollment steps apply.
Whether this is an individual membership or one shared with a team or employer affects who pays, who approves, and whose details are entered.
A hard renewal deadline or conference date creates urgency and may determine whether standard processing time is sufficient.
Knowing whether the user already has login credentials ready determines if account recovery steps need to be planned first.
The preferred payment method (personal card, company card, invoice/PO) affects the steps and whether expense approval is needed beforehand.
Knowing what proof or confirmation the user needs (receipt, certificate, updated member ID) defines what 'done' actually looks like for them.

gold.taskDescription: The user wants to complete an online renewal of their professional association membership, which may involve locating login credentials, selecting a membership tier, and processing payment.

questions.title: Which professional association are you renewing with?
questions.description: Identify the specific association (e.g., IEEE, APA, PMI, ABA) so the correct renewal portal and process can be targeted.

questions.title: Is your current membership still active or already expired?
questions.description: Determine whether the membership is lapsed, which may trigger late fees, a re-enrollment flow, or a different section of the website.

questions.title: Is this membership for you personally or on behalf of an employer?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is an individual or organisational membership, as employer-sponsored renewals may require approval or different billing details.

questions.title: Is there a specific date by which the renewal must be completed?
questions.description: Identify any hard deadline — such as an event, certification cycle, or late-fee cutoff — that sets the urgency of the task.

questions.title: Do you already have your login credentials for the member portal?
questions.description: Determine if account access is ready or if password recovery and account lookup steps need to be built into the plan first.

questions.title: How do you plan to pay — personal card, company card, or invoice?
questions.description: Clarify the payment method so any prior steps (expense pre-approval, PO generation) can be included in the plan.

questions.title: What confirmation do you need once the renewal is done?
questions.description: Establish what 'successfully renewed' looks like — e.g., a receipt email, updated member ID card, downloadable certificate — so no follow-up steps are missed.
